prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a person’s hands at night, illuminated by cool, moody street lighting. The subject is holding a modern smartphone in one hand, displaying a bright, high-contrast app interface with a pink electric scooter and a prominent green “Confirm” button. In the other hand, the person holds a sleek, red-and-white contactless payment card with a Mastercard logo and a stylized “Uala” branding. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an urban setting with metallic elements and hints of a bicycle or scooter, enhancing the sense of depth and focus on the hands and devices. The color palette contrasts the dark, bluish ambient tones of the night with the vivid, inviting colors of the phone screen and card. The overall style is realistic with a touch of cinematic flair, using shallow depth of field and naturalistic lighting to evoke a sense of modern urban life and digital convenience.
